name: 字节蓝
description: 字节蓝青渐变 #1677FF/#05D4CD，渐变胶囊标题，科技商务感，适合 SaaS 产品、技术方案介绍

styles.h1: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: #1d2129; text-align: center; letter-spacing: 0.1em; line-height: 1.2; background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(22,119,255,0.02), rgba(5,212,205,0.05), rgba(22,119,255,0.02)); border-radius: 4px; border-top: 3px solid #1677FF; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(5,212,205,0.5); margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px;
styles.h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #ffffff; text-align: center; letter-spacing: 0.1em; line-height: 1.4; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1677FF, #05D4CD); border-radius: 8px 24px 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(5,212,205,0.15); margin-top: 48px; margin-bottom: 24px;
styles.h3: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #1677FF; line-height: 1.6; border-left: 3px solid #1677FF; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(22,119,255,0.08), rgba(5,212,205,0.03)); border-right: 1px solid rgba(22,119,255,0.1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(22,119,255,0.1); margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 12px;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #4e5969; line-height: 1.8; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 19px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 4px solid #05D4CD; background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(22,119,255,0.05), rgba(5,212,205,0.03)); margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; font-size: 15px; color: #4e5969; line-height: 1.8; border-bottom: 0.2px solid rgba(5,212,205,0.1); border-top: 0.2px solid rgba(5,212,205,0.1); border-right: 0.2px solid rgba(5,212,205,0.1);
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 10px; display: block; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(22,119,255,0.1); background: #ffffff; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 40px; margin-bottom: 40px; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(22,119,255,0), #1677FF, #05D4CD, rgba(5,212,205,0)); border: none;
styles.code: background: rgba(5,212,205,0.1); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 90%; color: #05D4CD; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, Menlo, monospace;
styles.pre: background: #f7f8fa; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(22,119,255,0.1); color: #1d2129; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-all;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 3px; background: linear-gradient(to right, #1677FF, #05D4CD);
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #1d2129; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, Menlo, monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px; font-size: 15px; border-spacing: 0; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
styles.th: background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(22,119,255,0.05), rgba(5,212,205,0.05)); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(5,212,205,0.1); text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: #1677FF;
styles.ol li::marker: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; min-width: 22px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(22,119,255,0.1), rgba(5,212,205,0.1)); color: #1677FF; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 10px; margin-top: 4px;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #4e5969; line-height: 1.75; letter-spacing: 0.5px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #999999; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
styles.h4: font-size: 17px; font-weight: bold; color: #1677FF; border-left: 2px solid #1677FF; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h5: font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; color: #555555; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h6: font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: #888888; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
